title: Scatter or bubble
text: Plot x and y points; a size per point turns it into a bubble chart.

title: Zoom and pan
text: Zoom along x or both axes, with an optional crosshair through the active point.

title: Keyboard points
text: One tab stop; points ordered by x, Up and Down switch series.

title: Data table fallback
text: A generated summary of ranges and a table with the exact values.

title: Not color alone
text: Series differ by color and marker shape.
